KaTeX 0.18.4 — CSS and fonts bundled with Notey

Project: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
Release: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.18.4
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.4.tgz

The CSS is licensed under the MIT License (LICENSE).
Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Khan Academy and other contributors.

The font files are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
(OFL-1.1.txt). FONT-NOTICES.txt preserves their original copyright and
Reserved Font Name statements from the fonts' name tables. These include
Design Science, Inc. and Khan Academy. All 60 WOFF2, WOFF and TTF assets
and the stylesheet are copied byte-for-byte from the official package.
No fonts are modified or renamed. The OFL permits bundling the fonts with
software; the font files may not be sold by themselves.

Hugo 0.166.0 includes KaTeX 0.18.4 for build-time math rendering. This folder
contains the matching CSS and fonts, not a client-side rendering script.
Mermaid carries its own separate MIT-licensed KaTeX JavaScript component.

PROVENANCE.json records the source and verified archive checksums.
VENDOR-MANIFEST.json records all shipped file checksums. Keep this notice,
LICENSE, OFL-1.1.txt, FONT-NOTICES.txt and those manifests with redistributed
copies, including generated sites. Notey's MIT license does not replace
the font license.
